name: mattermost-rtl-persian
author: Amir Zouerami
description: Mattermost RTL plugin for Persian language support

scripts.pack: npm run build && rm -rf dist/plugin dist/mattermost-rtl-persian.tar.gz && mkdir -p dist/plugin/webapp/dist && cp plugin.json dist/plugin/plugin.json && cp -R webapp/dist/* dist/plugin/webapp/dist/ && tar -czf dist/mattermost-rtl-persian.tar.gz -C dist/plugin .
